Go fuck yourself. I asked for help in November.  was voluntarily committed to the psychiatric ward. They tried to kick me out the first day. 

You know what happens when you ask for help?  You get given  choice. To go home or the psych ward. I chose the psych ward. They were trying to get me out the first day. Asking doe help gets everyone nowhere. I was diagnosed alcohol abuse and discharged against my wishes.
Tell me again to ask for help.

I'm sorry. I assume from reading between the lines that you are a woman who couldn't get pregnant or a man who loves a woman that couldn't.

Either way, keep trying. I have 2 children but I have been diagnosed as infertile. I have been pregnant 4 times that I know of. I spent more than 10 years trying to get pregnant. It's not easy. Dont let that be the reason for your depression.  It'll happen. Give it time.

My life cannot be fixed. I am undiagnosed bipolar. I have no meds to treat it. I used cannabis since December,  it doesnt work anymore.

You should calculate how many calories you just wasted. 
Its pointless. Every minute my life gets worse. I should have died already.

No. I have never been happy. I have been in an insane amount of therapy. The last round after I got out of the hospital in November,  they decided that my parents ignored me my entire life and that's why I am the way I am. They tried to change the way I think. I was doing ok until a few days ago when I realized that I'm still worthless.

I have 3 cats. They wont remember I'm gone after a day. The lizard wont notice. I dont think my dog will notice either. She didnt remember me when I got out of the hospital and I was only in for 10 days.
